newsitem.title: USA: PLD Telekom sees profitable future.
newsitem.headline: PLD Telekom sees profitable future.

text.p: PLD Telekom Inc, a provider of telecommunication services in the emerging markets of the former Soviet Union, said Wendesday that it believes it will achieve overall profitability by maintining trends apparent in the first quarter, strong revenue growth and containing expenses.
The company reported a net loss of $0.14 per share in the quarter ended March 31.
PLD said that its Teleport-TP network rollout is progressing with 21 sites currently installed and a further 24 programmed for this year.

The company also said that it expects the continued expansion of the network to result in significant revenue increases for Teleport-TP during the second half of 1997 and through 1998, as it meets increasing customer demand for high quality, long distance services across Russia.

PLD said that its underlying financial performance continues to improve, with its first quarter loss almost entirely attributable to non-cash items, including license amortization charges, as well as interest payable on the capital we raised in 1996 to fund the development of the company.
